Anya: Heads-up: bringing up a new 13B variant on dedicated for onboarding. Ran quick int8 vs int4 quant experiments — need a short unit-econ + product recommendation for GTN. TL;DR numbers below.

Liam: drop the numbers pls

Anya: ```
int8 (8-bit) - p95 latency: 220ms @ 1req/s, tokens/sec: 950, approx infra cost: $0.23 / 1k tokens
int4 (4-bit) - p95 latency: 160ms @ 1req/s, tokens/sec: 1400, approx infra cost: $0.14 / 1k tokens
Quality delta (eval-suite-v3):
  QA EM: int8 78.4% -> int4 76.7% (Δ -1.7)
  Summ ROUGE-L: 0.42 -> 0.40 (Δ -0.02)
  Hallucination rate: int8 3.1% -> int4 5.8%
Notes: int4 shows occasional tail instability for contexts >1024 tokens, also more variance on generation length.
```

Liam: Where did cost come from? need assumptions for GTN unit econ

Anya: ```
Assumptions:
- GPU: A100-80GB equivalent pricing used (shared pool)
- Perf harness v2, microbench at 1req/s and 8x batching for cost extrapolation
- Avg generation per request: 64 tokens
- Infra $/GPU-hr: $0.70 (effective after amortized infra + ops)
Cost calc simplified: cost_per_token = (gpu_hour_cost / 3600) / tokens_per_sec
```

Priya: Quick product/GTN scorecard suggestion: keep it minimal so PMs can act. Proposed fields (weights):
- Quality score (0.6) -> composite of QA EM + summary ROUGE normalized
- Hallucination penalty (0.2) -> absolute rate allowed <= 4% pass
- p95 latency (0.15) -> pass if <= 250ms
- Cost delta (0.05) -> shown to PMs but not auto-blocking
Pass rule: weighted_score >= 0.75 AND hallucination <= 4.5%

Kai: Ops recommendations for rollout and cost controls:
- Default route: int8 for interactive product traffic (meets p95 SLAs)
- Low-cost route: int4 for async/batch jobs (embeddings, background summarization) with lower SLOs
- Canary plan: 5% int4 -> monitor hallucination & QA EM -> 20% -> 100% (auto-rollback if hallucination spike > +2pp)
- Enable prefix KV caching and batching=4 for interactive to reduce cost ~15%
Example rollout snippet:```
route: prod-default
model: 13B-openx-int8
canary: 5%
fallback: 13B-openx-int8
metrics: [qa_em, hallucination_rate, p95_latency]
```

eval-bot: Automated eval (run 2026-04-07T10:12Z): int4 triggered a regression alert for summarization (delta ROUGE-L -0.02, p<0.01) and hallucination rate exceeded GTN advisory threshold. Flag: SUMM_REGRESSION_INT4

Priya: That matches scorecard: int4 fails hallucination constraint. Good candidate for a gated offering, not default.

Anya: Recommendation (final):
- Default: 13B-int8 (interactive) — good balance of quality + cost.
- Optional: 13B-int4 for batch/async with explicit QA gating and lower SLOs.
- GTN guidance: show delta table, include rollout snippet above, add note to pin model version and enable automatic fallback to int8 on hallucination alert.
- Ops action: I'll open a ticket to create the GTN doc, setup 5% canary, and add the eval-suite check to the canary gate.

Liam: :thumbsup:

Priya: I'll draft the product blurb for GTN and add the scorecard widget (ETA EOD).

Kai: I'll add batching + caching presets to Redwood Optimize recommendations for this model.

Anya: Thanks all — will follow up with the ticket link. :eyes:
